digest.component_or_area: review-bot persistent tickets clone and autodeploy
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS is not refreshed during normal redeploy because the Dockerfile entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, preserving divergent history.
The entrypoint invokes ensure-script outside the PAT block so convergence must run even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, but the script currently does not fetch or reset divergent clones.
Deploy path omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh from BOT_PATHS in autodeploy.sh, preventing changes to that script from triggering redeployment.

A failed explicit-refspec fetch due to missing credentials or unreachable origin must exit successfully to avoid aborting an already-cast Gerrit vote, while preserving the local tip and emitting operator warnings.

Pre-epoch local clones with readable prior remote tips that are ancestors of the current local tip must adopt the newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit, but only through a narrow reclaim path that proves no local-only commits exist.
Convergence must preserve the union safety invariant for compatible stores using rebar._store.sync.reconverge for equal, behind, ahead, and same-epoch divergent histories.
